bio_en: Hakob Tashjian, known as Gagik, was born in Arabkir in 1872 and fought as a fedayi with the armed bands in the villages of Vaspurakan. A senior member of the ARF in Alexandria, he remained a model of the old generation of Dashnaks, devoted, self-sacrificing and uncompromising. On a visit to Cairo, talking at the Yusaber office about his past and leafing through an album of old fighters, he said that he wished only to go back to the homeland and keep a few dozen sheep. He died suddenly there on 3 February 1936 at the age of 64 and was buried in Alexandria on 6 February.
notes: Compiled from the archive review, 2026-10-12. Confidence: high. Quote #21 is his.
